RequestId.description: The gateway's request ID (UUIDv7), also the attempt ID of a root request.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait; only a cooling-down route sends it.

ShouldRetryFalse.description: Permanent refusals (unsupported capability, budget, price or token-reservation denials) tell SDKs not to retry.

OpenAiBadGateway.description: The provider was unavailable or returned an invalid or incomplete response

OpenAiBadRequest.description: HTTP 400 invalid_request_error for malformed or unsupported request fields, or (on non-generation workloads) unsupported_capability; error.code distinguishes them. System One validation is documented separately at 422.

OpenAiNotFound.description: The model does not exist or is not available to this key and workspace (model_not_found)

OpenAiNotImplemented.description: A capability no registered deployment supports (unsupported_capability); permanent

OpenAiPayloadTooLarge.description: The request body exceeds the route's cap. A declared Content-Length over the cap is refused by the body-limit layer with the plain text `length limit exceeded`, before any handler runs; a streamed body is refused by the handler with this JSON error (a different type/code on /v1/embeddings).

OpenAiTooManyRequests.description: Rate or concurrency limit (rate_limit_error), or a permanent budget, unresolved-usage or token-reservation denial (x-should-retry: false)

OpenAiUnauthorized.description: Missing, malformed, duplicate, unknown, revoked or no-longer-valid inference key (always authentication_error)

OpenAiUnavailable.description: Authentication, catalog or accounting storage unavailable, provider configuration unavailable, an unbounded price, or every route cooling down (Retry-After)

AnthropicErrorEnvelope.description: Anthropic-shaped /v1/messages error (protocols/messages.rs). It carries NO gateway machine code: unsupported_capability, budget_exceeded and the rest cannot be told apart except by their message.

AnthropicErrorType.description: Anthropic error.type. Anthropic's shape has no machine code, so a budget denial is a rate_limit_error distinguishable only by its message.

oneOf.description: encoding_format base64: padded standard base64 of little-endian float32 values (four bytes per dimension).

EmbeddingUsage.description: Input tokens only (total equals prompt); there are no completion tokens and no monetary field.

FileErrorEnvelope.description: Files API error (protocols/files.rs): param names the offending field, or is null. The exhaustive code list is documented with the Files operations.

info.description: INCOMPLETE contract (#82 PR2): the operations of areas models, embeddings, rerank, systemone, images, chat, responses, messages and the two realtime refusals are complete and wire-validated against the real handlers; every other operation is an explicit, counted placeholder. Every operation authenticates with an inference key only (Bearer; /v1/messages also accepts x-api-key, GET /v1/realtime also the openai-insecure-api-key.<key> WebSocket subprotocol, never both); inference keys never authorize management and admin tokens never authorize inference. Live key, workspace, catalog and budget checks remain authoritative. The OpenAI-shaped, Anthropic-shaped, job and file error envelopes are distinct schemas and never the management ErrorEnvelope; /v1/messages errors carry no gateway machine code. x-omg-* extensions state what OpenAPI 3.1 cannot express (see docs/openapi/inference/README.md).
info.title: Open Model Gateway inference API

post.description: Real gateway text/function generation frontend. Admission checks live key, workspace, model and provider capabilities. Default root body cap is fixed 2097152 bytes: declared Content-Length above it is rejected before decoding; Messages uses Anthropic errors, other routes plain text. Unknown fields are 400 invalid_request_error. Usage counters are emitted only when known; Messages message_start input_tokens:0 is a compatibility placeholder, never accounting. Native-only fields and translated-route refusals are described below.

x-omg-sse.event_field: absent; message/error classify JSON data, not named events
ordered: zero or more content/tool/finish/optional requested usage chunks
one [DONE], or final OpenAI error without [DONE]
x-omg-sse.usage: Only with stream_options.include_usage:true; absent or null until all required counters are known.

200.description: JSON completion or ordered SSE. Errors after opening a stream are terminal error frames, never fabricated successful termination.

x-omg-refusals.trigger: unknown fields, invalid types, bounds, malformed JSON or unsupported request field
unequal non-null max_tokens and max_completion_tokens, n other than 1, non-null refusal or unsupported message/tool shape
no configured deployment supports requested capability

post.description: String-only, non-streaming embeddings (protocols/embeddings.rs). Embeddings are an input-only workload: usage never has completion tokens. A capability no deployment supports is 501 unsupported_capability (not the 400 of the other workloads). Oversized bodies: the shared 2 MiB cap.

200.description: The embeddings, one per input, in input order

body_bytes.source: apps/gateway/src/http.rs request body cap (fixed, not configurable)

post.description: OpenAI-compatible subset (protocols/images.rs): base64 images only, never URLs. Unknown fields (output_format, background, style, user, ...) are refused with 400 invalid_request_error.

200.description: The generated images and observed usage
